title: 専門ゼミ
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III
keywords: Aeronautics and Astronautics 2.Aircraft/Spacecraft design 3.Problem finding 4.Career building 5.3D data
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)propose a problem for Design Project III. (2)study a procedure to solve the problem. (3)master the design, production, production technology. (4)develop the basic abilities needed for design and production in order to suggest feasible ideas. (5)learn the importance of cooperation with society.
advice: Students will: (1) clarify the knowledge and skills necessary to accomplish a project carried out in Design Project III and confirm their ability to perform these. (2) clarify the knowledge and skills you need to augment your existing knowledge and skills, and apply them to learning new skills. (3) clarify the aim and the action plan of the Design Project III project as the class proceeds. (4) clarify the Design Project III proposal and evaluate these learning results, and confirm the degree of acquisition. (5) receive the following instructions from their lab teacher: -rules and the administration methods in the laboratory -usage of the apparatuses -other conventions of lab use. Note: The description above are the current plan; the details will be distributed at the time of the first class of the specialized seminar.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and skills to take this course are presented in the first lecture of each laboratory. Students cannot take Design Project III if the unit of specialized seminar (this subject) is not obtained.

activityGoals.body: Students have a clear image of the aim and the action plan of their Design Project III.
Students can explain the theme of their Design Project III.
Students acquire the knowledge and skills to independently accomplish their Design Project III.
Students come to understand laboratory conventions through experience.
Students understand the safety management guidelines to perform experiments and studies safely.
Students survey future courses and decide the direction of their study.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students make a realistic enforcement plan for their Design Project III Students understand and carry out the safety management guidelines to perform an experiment and a study safely.
achievementLevels.standard: Students have a clear image for their Design Project III. Students understand the safety management guidelines to perform an experiment and a study safely.

lessons.content: [guidance] Students understand the following: (1)objectives of the subject, summary and action target based on this syllabus to be distributed. (2)concrete achievement level of the part of the education target of the department of aeronautics and astronautics this subject carries. (3)summary of project activities in Design Project III. (4)Students should check the content of the lectures and their current situation by themselves.
lessons.operation: The guidance based on distributed document
lessons.assignments: Students check the area of activity of each laboratory by document investigation and visit.

lessons.content: Students learn the procedure to carry out a project safely and conduct a self-check on class content and attendance.
lessons.operation: Question and answer on lecture and safety management based on the safety guidelines for an experiment and studies
lessons.assignments: Students identify the item of the associated security guidelines. Students check preventive measures against possible accidents and take countermeasures. Students make a report. Preparations for lessons and next practice.

lessons.content: [career building] Students investigate a company they wish to join or a type of job. Students think about their future Lectures by outside lecturers may be given as needed. Students should check the content of the lectures and their current situation by themselves.
lessons.assignments: Students perform self-analysis and company research.

lessons.content: [Rearranging information and the interim self-check] Students carry out rearranging of information and the summary of references necessary to perform their project. Based on the result, students look back on their activity up to now and confirm their understanding of the project theme. Students should check the content of the lectures and their current situation by themselves.
lessons.operation: Check of the reference document and questions and answers.
lessons.assignments: Research and writing on the proposal Preparations for lessons and next practice.

lessons.content: [The acquisition of the knowledge necessary for project accomplishment] Students learn the basic theory and basic technology necessary to accomplish their project. Students may also learn design and manufacturing techniques using 3D data. Students should check the content of the lectures and their current situation by themselves.
lessons.operation: Lecture and by the teacher and practice Presentation of the practice results by the students Questions and answers about the project
lessons.assignments: Preparations for lessons and next practice.

lessons.content: [The acquisition of the knowledge necessary for project accomplishment] Students learn the basic theory and basic technology necessary to accomplish their project. Students should check the content of the lectures and their current situation by themselves.
lessons.operation: Lecture by the teacher and practice Presentation of the practice results by the students Questions and answers about the project
lessons.assignments: Preparations for lessons and next practice.

lessons.content: [The acquisition of the knowledge necessary for project accomplishment] Students learn the basic theory and basic technology necessary to accomplish their project. Students should check the content of the lectures and their current situation by themselves.

[Presentation and improvement of work] Students submit deliverables such as proposals and reply to questions. Students should check the content of the lectures and their current situation by themselves.
